list: the official 55 trophies, as listed by Exophase / PSNProfiles
note: Names, descriptions and grades are the official list. Every guide below is written in my own words from the cited sources; where a step is not yet confirmed in a published guide, the guide says so instead of inventing one.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum is automatic: collect the other 54 and it pops. No online trophies, no DLC trophies — the whole list is single-player. PowerPyx's estimate for the set is roughly 200 hours at 4/10 difficulty, and the 100% gold is the part that takes longest.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Finish Gone Fishing, the first main mission in Chapter 1, and this is yours when the mission wraps up. It is a story trophy, so there is no way to miss it.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Play Chapter 1 through to its end and this unlocks as the chapter closes. Do the Chapter 1 meditation with Lucia at Jason's house before you move on, though — Positive Mental Attitude is the one trophy that might be missable.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: This one comes from finishing Chapter 2: play its missions in story order and it pops as Chapter 3 begins. The Coffee Break mission halfway through unlocks character swapping between Jason and Lucia, and duo free-roam with it.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Another chapter trophy: finish all of Chapter 3's main missions and it unlocks at the end. This chapter opens several side threads — Yasmani's jobs, Randy's car list, Tyrone's labs — worth picking up as they appear, though none of them can be missed.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 4's missions, including Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown, and this unlocks when the chapter ends. One optional mission in this chapter also unlocks robbing the big bank vaults.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The gold story trophy: complete the final main mission and it pops during the credits. You keep free-roam after the story, and the 100% checklist shows up under Progress > Stats, so finishing the story locks nothing the platinum needs.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run and this pops at the end of the mission. There are no medals or bonus objectives to worry about — completing the mission is enough.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish The Cartel Heist, a main mission in Chapter 3, and this unlocks when the mission ends. Keep playing the story in order and it will come to you.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish Child's Play, a main mission in Chapter 4, and this pops at the end of it. No extra objective beyond completing the mission.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish Headliners, a main mission in Chapter 4, and this unlocks at the end of it. Just follow the story missions in order.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish VCIA Takedown, a main mission in Chapter 4, and this pops at the end of it. The airport setting is a preview of Catch Me If You Can, earned later by stealing a docked passenger plane at VCIA.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory, a main mission in Chapter 5, and this unlocks at the end of it. It is one of the last missions before the finale.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold for reaching 100% completion — the biggest time sink in the list and, in PowerPyx's view, the hardest trophy. The checklist only appears after the story (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion), but progress from during the story counts toward it. The targets are lenient, closer to 60% true completion: 200 of 277 base vehicles scanned, 100 of 255 animals studied, 70 of 80 challenges, 15 of 18 card sets and meditations. Nothing here is missable — everything can be done in free-roam after the story. Push Square's checklist adds the robbery numbers: all 39 gang operations, all 8 bank vaults, 22 bank jobs, 34 smash 'n' grabs and 50 stick-ups.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Push Square — GTA 6: 100% Completion Checklist — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-100percent-completion-checklist
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts — and do not stop there, because 100% completion wants 300. Stunts come in four flavours: 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps; you can mix them however you like. PowerPyx reckons the under-the-bridge ones are fastest. Progress is under Progress > Activities > Stunts, and completed stunts stay marked on the map.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Do each of the 9 activity types once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, playing a video game, winning a race or drone race, and doing a stunt. Progress > Activities shows which types you have tried. Most will happen on their own while you work on the other trophies.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Win a gold medal in every one of the 42 shooting-range challenges, spread across 12 range locations — PowerPyx links a location guide for all 12. The medals are not too tough, and range work also builds your Focus level, which helps with Gunslinger. Go range by range and retry a challenge until gold pops.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations — a single win at each location does it; you do not need to win every race. PowerPyx links a guide to all 14 locations. Drone wins also tick the race activity for Master of None.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. There are 40 race locations in total, so choose the short, simple ones first — PowerPyx links a guide to all 40. Racing counts as one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Win a fishing challenge against Cal. You meet Cal in the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui; after that he texts you and marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon. Follow his fishing questline to the challenge and beat him. Fishing is one of the 9 activity types for Master of None.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete a single arcade game (the game calls them Video Games). There are four: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind and Bang For Your Buck. The first three are playable on the TV at home from Chapter 1; Bang For Your Buck lives on arcade machines around Leonida. 'Complete' means finishing all of a game's levels once — the extra challenges are optional. Choose the one you enjoy most.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete Andy's optional questline — Lucia only. It appears on its own in Chapter 3: playing as Lucia, you get a call from Andy, then a text with her home address in Belville. Her five quests are Climbing the Cellerichain (parts 1–3), Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass; the trophy pops after the last one. The line stays open after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's optional questline. It appears on its own in Chapter 1: after the Island Dreams mission he calls you, then shows up with a green KR icon in Key Lento. He sends you diving for treasure at shipwrecks — 7 of them in several sets, marked with purple chest icons — using the metal detector on the seabed, then bring the finds back. Follow it under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees. He is unavailable for a stretch in later chapters but comes back, so nothing here is missable.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: See Billy's optional questline through to the end. It shows up on its own after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at the Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County. The five quests are Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes — finish the last and the trophy pops. The questline is still there after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Finish 8 Strangers & Freaks mission strands. Not every stranger questline counts: the character lines for Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy and Eddie do not. PowerPyx confirms Kirk (Skunk Ape hunts), Kyle (McKittrick Farm), Yago (street racing and mentoring) and Pilot Pete (plane deliveries) among the ones that do. Strangers are still findable in free-roam after the story, and the trophy list tracks your count. Guide authors are still discovering more qualifying strangers, so check the cited guide for the latest list.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's optional questline, Randy's Wish List. It appears on its own after the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS, in which you steal the Zorrusso for him and unlock the Key Cloner. After that he wants 16 sports cars: some he marks on the map, others you can steal off the street — scan a car with the WAiNK app to see if it is on his list, then drive it to his garage in west Vice City; good condition pays more. Sports cars turn up often around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach. The list is under Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List, and it can be finished after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete Tyrone's optional questline — Jason only. It appears on its own after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty: purple markers show Synthetic Labs in Vice City, and you need to destroy the labs (the quest Take Out Kitty Litter). Once enough labs are gone, Tyrone hands you the second quest, Spin On This, to shut the labs down for good; finishing it pops the trophy. It stays open after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POTENTIALLY MISSABLE TROPHY — do the Chapter 1 step before Chapter 1 ends. Leonida has 18 meditation spots in 10 locations, and meditating at a spot with both Jason and Lucia counts double; track them under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations. The risky one: in Chapter 1, on the morning after the Down to Earth mission, speak to Lucia in the kitchen at Jason's house. She says she will meditate, walks to the balcony, and you follow and pick Accept. That meditation adds 1 to the counter but is not listed as a normal meditation spot, and PowerPyx says it is still unclear whether the trophy needs it — do it anyway to be safe. The last meditation cannot be done until both characters can play together, after Coffee Break in Chapter 2. The 100% checklist only wants 15 of 18 meditations, but this trophy wants all of them.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret Vogel. His line appears on its own after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break: playing as Jason, you get a text from Bret marking his first quest, Veteran Hunted, in Lummox County — Lucia cannot get it, so it is Jason-only. Meet him and he marks hunting spots with purple icons; hunt the animals he asks for and bring them in. The first quest hands you the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69, which you can pick up from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker. A single clean shot keeps an animal pristine and pays more, but it is not required. PowerPyx notes it is still unconfirmed exactly which animal pops this trophy, so follow Bret's marked quests instead of hunting at random.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Put together any 3 collectible card sets. There are 18 sets in the game, and 100% completion asks for 15, so this arrives long before that goal. PowerPyx links a guide covering all 18 set locations. A few magazine-style collectibles are inside story buildings that later become off-limits, but they turn up elsewhere too, and you never need every one — so no card set is missable.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Push Square — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.pushsquare.com/guides/gta-6-trophy-guide-and-roadmap
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Scan 100 WAiNK locations with the WAiNK app: hold up on the D-pad to open it at once, then hold R1 while looking at something scannable. Any 100 will do — the world holds more than 100, among them 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures. Scan whatever you pass during normal play and the trophy will come by itself. Scanning vehicles with the same app also feeds Whip It Good and the 100% vehicle counts.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Finish any 50 of the 80 challenges. The 100% checklist wants 70 of 80, so this pops along the way. Challenges sit in 8 groups of 10; view and track them under Progress > Challenges. Plenty finish on their own while you chase other trophies — save this for late, then pick the easiest ones left and skip the hardest, since you have 10 to spare here and 10 to spare for 100%.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Shake off a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you, then get out of the red heat zone. Duo free-roam only opens after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break — summon your partner by holding right on the D-pad and pressing triangle. Build chaos to 4 stars, then escape on a fast sports bike, weaving through traffic; shoot down any helicopter that chases you. PowerPyx's easiest escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County, where police struggle to follow and the helicopter loses sight of you. The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone. Bank-vault robberies always trigger 4 stars, so you will probably earn this while doing those anyway.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: With your partner with you (possible after Coffee Break in Chapter 2), rob 3 shops back-to-back without ever dropping your wanted level — the flashing wanted level has to stay active throughout. Pack an armored vest, sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation and healing items, and loot a couple of items per shop, ideally blowing the safe in the back room with sticky bombs. If it has not popped after the third shop, hit a fourth — the unlock lags by about half a minute after you leave the third shop. The 3 jewelry stores in north Vice City are a good spot, open after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs in Chapter 3.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Leonida has 557 vehicles at launch — cars, bikes, boats, helicopters and planes. The quickest method is the WAiNK app: hold up on the D-pad, look at a vehicle and hold R1 to scan it. Scanning is enough; you do not need to drive it. Stand on a busy road and scan everything that passes. Totals are under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles. Since 100% completion wants 200 base-model vehicles scanned, this trophy comes for free on that road.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Drop 5 enemies inside a single use of Combat Focus. Trigger it with L3 + R3 while aiming a firearm: time slows, weak points light up, and the purple focus bar drains. Boost your focus first — eat or drink, wash up at home, take Adrenaline to stretch the slowdown — then line up 5 enemies, such as criminals at a gang operation, and take them down fast with an accurate full-auto rifle like the Duke 556. Body armor helps you step out of cover. Per PowerPyx it does not seem to work on soldiers, police or civilians. Focus has 4 levels, built up through shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots, so it gets easier late in the game and may pop by itself.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Steal a large passenger plane docked at a departure terminal at VCIA (Vice City International Airport) — planes sitting on the open airfield do not count. The simplest is the one at terminals E3/E4: drive through a fence around the airfield, walk to the plane by the boarding bridge, use the stairs and door beside the bridge to get in, go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane to the runway, take off and fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) from the airport. The unlock lags a little, so keep flying until it pops.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Take a military tank — a Rhino — and use it until this pops. The tanks are parked in the south of Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County. Get in through the gate, or take the stunt jump by the south-east entrance, climb into a tank and open fire on enemies until it unlocks.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being spotted. First finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs: it unlocks the Snap Gun for silently picking alarmed doors, and marks jewelry store robberies with green icons. Go in through the back door with the Snap Gun — kicking the door sets the alarm off — find the note with the safe code in the back room, loot the safe, destroy the security footage and switch the alarm off, then leave. The trophy pops shortly after you walk out. Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a good spot.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob any 5 bank vaults and get away; 100% completion wants all 8, so this pops en route. Start with the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… (it appears on its own from story progress): tail a security van to a bank, wait for the guard to carry the cash briefcase inside and the vault to open, then slip in quickly and rob it — bring your partner, because you cannot carry all the cash alone. Afterwards, pay Yasmani $10,000 a tip (after his earlier Payday Loans quests) to mark security vans with purple icons and follow them to banks. Every vault robbery instantly brings a 4-star wanted level, so escape on a fast motorcycle and swap vehicles to become unrecognizable. A single vault can pay up to $205,000.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck, then get clear of the red heat radius. The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… does it for you: it is the same mission that opens bank vaults, and tailing the armored truck to a bank and emptying the vault counts as robbing the truck. An earlier route: armored trucks drive around near banks in Vice City — block one, plant a sticky bomb on its back door and blow it open (sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop once his quests are done), then leave the heat radius; a Pay 'n' Spray helps. Since 100% completion needs all 8 large bank jobs anyway, most players pick this up without trying.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Unfog the entire map of Leonida. The map begins covered in black fog; fly a plane over every fogged patch until none is left. PowerPyx links a guide to the fastest plane and route for the job. A plane beats walking or driving by a wide margin, and you can get one early in Chapter 1.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
Exophase / PSNProfiles — official trophy list (name, description, grade)

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation for each of the 9 gangs. There are 39 gang operations in total, and 100% completion wants all 39, so this pops early on that road. Operations show as yellow icons when you get near them, and many are marked on their own from story progress. Each gang's count is under Progress > Gangs.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Head to the Ocean View Rooftop Bar on Ocean Beach, order an Apple Martini and drink it standing next to the bar. The trophy pops once you drink it with the view ahead of you. A quick one-off — save it for cleanup.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Steal one particular car — the blue Banshee — from the vehicle showroom in the south of Vice City, and drive it straight out through the showroom window. You can only take it once you have the Key Cloner from the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' Gs: hack into the car, drive forward through the window and keep going down the street — the unlock lags slightly. Only this blue Banshee counts; it is a nod to the Banshee from GTA III.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Take all 3 key valuables from Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, one of the gang operations. Bring sticky bombs from an Ammu-Nation — you need them to crack the safe. The items: the luxury watch in the south-east office, the unique shotgun Gutterball Moreland 850 on the table in the north-east corner, and the safe in the north-east hallway office. You first visit during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling. The trophy pops after you escape the police, not when you pick up the third item, and you do not need all three in one trip: if the robbery icon respawns later you can come back for whatever is left, so it is not missable. You do not need to kill the enemies.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Have Jason and Lucia at maximum strength at the same time. Character swapping only starts after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, so this cannot be done before then. Find Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia (heart icon). Buy a fitness club membership and always train as a pair — summon your partner with right on the D-pad plus triangle: while one character works out, the other finishes their training automatically, so progress doubles. Fitness clubs are dotted all over Vice City (filter the map by Activities), and home workouts are possible after the story.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Your criminal profile moves with what you do — 500 profile actions earns this. The trophy list shows your running count when you tap the trophy. To see each action land, turn on profile notifications under Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile; a small demon face appears when one counts. Clean, stealthy robberies and destroying evidence pull you toward Professional; knocking foes out without killing them is Hardened; killing enemies and civilians is Violent; mass killing — driving over gravestones included — is Psycho; and relentless excessive violence can lock you into Irredeemable permanently, after which cops shoot on sight. It accrues on its own across the other trophies and the 100% checklist, so leave it alone early — if it is still short at the end, it can be farmed quickly, at the cost of pushing your profile toward the harsher tiers.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: NOT YET CONFIRMED in published guides: PowerPyx currently lists this trophy as unknown, thought to be tied to the Payday Loans store from the prologue. The description — second time's the charm — hints at succeeding at something on a second try, but no guide has pinned down the exact trigger. Do not grind Payday Loans robberies on this hint alone; PowerPyx is updating its guide as players confirm the trigger, so check it again before spending time on it.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Finish the UFO easter egg. Go alone, at night after 2 AM, to the road north-west of the Starlet Motel in Kelly County. Now and then a blinking car is parked at the roadside — if it is not there, drive away and return until it shows up. Follow the path from the car into the woods and you will spot the UFO (a bright blue light in the sky). Walk up to it and it drops a woman it abducted; speak to her, offer to help, and go back to her car at the roadside as she asks. The spawn is a little random and not guaranteed, so stay patient and try another in-game night.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: From a motorcycle or push bike, kick 10 pedestrians with a melee attack (square) inside 60 seconds. Crowded spots such as Vice City or Ocean Beach are best: ride slowly through a crowd and kick as you pass people. The 60-second window opens with the first kick, so keep moving and do not pause between kicks.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 of marked bills through your contacts in total — it accumulates across all robberies, not in a single trip. First complete the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (meeting Raul's crew), which unlocks the Dye Pack Jammer needed to launder marked bills at all. Then rob banks and Payday Loans stores and take the marked bills to a fence; Yasmani in Vice City pays the most. It comes naturally while doing every robbery for the 100% checklist, and a single bank vault can hold up to $205,000. Bank vaults themselves only unlock after the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is….
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across shops of every type. Pricey goods get you there fastest: guns from the 24 Ammu-Nations, car mods from the 14 mod shops, tattoos from the 11 tattoo studios. The rest counts too — 67 clothing stores, 17 footwear stores, 18 hair and beauty salons, 15 electronics stores and 19 Pay 'n' Sprays. It builds up by itself over a full playthrough, so buy gear when you need it instead of saving it all for the end.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garages that are for sale (the 4 story-related garages do not count). All eight together cost $160,000. They become buyable after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver, when you steal the Crawler for Moses: a notification says the Vice City Real Estate app has been installed on your phone, and you buy the garages through that app. Robberies are the quickest money — especially the higher-value ones in Chapters 3–4 — and bank vaults later pay up to $205,000 apiece.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: The Scooter Bros app — installed after the Chapter 2 mission Moses — lets a registered vehicle be delivered to you anywhere. You need parking first, so buy garages (see Little Boxes): every garage adds spots. Then take stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray followed by Register in his garage. Early on he only takes vehicles with no tracker; from Chapter 3, cars with standard trackers can be registered at any Pay 'n' Spray instead. Registration is not free, so stick to cheap low-end cars and bikes.
sources: PowerPyx — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap — https://www.powerpyx.com/gta-6-grand-theft-auto-vi-trophy-guide-roadmap/
